entries.title: Deliver Mining Supplies
entries.text: Gundren Rockseeker hired the party to take a wagon of mining supplies to Barthen's Provisions in the frontier town of Phandalin.

entries.title: Gundren's Payment
entries.text: Gundren promised each party member 10 gold pieces once the supplies are delivered to Barthen's Provisions.

entries.title: Gundren Rockseeker
entries.text: A dwarf friend who hired the party and rode ahead to Phandalin with the warrior Sildar Hallwinter.

entries.title: Sildar Hallwinter
entries.text: A warrior travelling with Gundren Rockseeker, who rode ahead of the party toward Phandalin.
